DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS).

The history of prematurity (born after the 32nd week, implying possible earlier gestation or still preterm if "after" was a typo for "before," but even 32 weeks is at risk) and C-section delivery are strong risk factors for RDS. I am requesting immediate imaging to confirm the diagnosis.
